assertions: Public input selects only an opaque configured store and cannot submit a filesystem path or approval boolean.
The hidden runtime resolves the exact canonical ready intake revision and verifies an exact local-write review grant.
One private atomic envelope binds the full revision, review grant receipt, idempotency key, storage time, deletion deadline and withdrawal mechanism.
Exact and concurrent replay returns one receipt and one record; another revision or idempotency key for the same submission fails closed.
The receipt proves local storage only and does not claim withdrawal, reply, platform write, knowledge write or further execution authority.
The isolated local-write probe removes its temporary store after verification.
